worksheets.title: Sheet1
values: Constituent interrogatives, focused NPs, subordinated/coordinated clauses; motivates P2 zone (position 2) as elements after first XP
po, pojo, tso, pa, tokwe, dipa, sha
pona tsidi-a [tokwe] [pa] wada todi-lipi laba ti -ta -iki
Wackernagel-like particles occurring after first XP; no fixed ordering among themselves; free forms
pona tsidi-a tokwe pa [wada todi-lipi] laba ti -ta -iki
Free argument NPs/PPs of any grammatical role; free constituent order derived from zones 1 and 3
e-, pi-, ja-, tsi-, pa-, ke-, noma-, shoma-, sho-

Left edge of maximal free occurrence domain (vpref–connect3). e-=empty/morphome; pi-...-ma=negative circumfix; ja-...-ti=interactional circumfix; tsi-=slowly; pa-=posterior; ke-=interrogative; noma-=in vain; shoma-=apart; sho-=still
Incorporated noun roots; closed class; phonologically identical to free nouns; no modifiers when incorporated; bear part-whole relation to P argument
Minimal free occurrence domain (vcore–vcore); bare verb root can be elliptical utterance; e.g. ba=see/feel, di=eat, olo=fall, iji=tie, kwaiya=arrive, oto=cough, piye=shoot

Zone: elements variably order among themselves but not with adjacent positions. Motion: -shawiya=do&go, -shana=going, -jajo=arrive&do, -shao=come&do, -wiki=going:P. Time of day: -sisa=at night, -wena=in morning, -tseiye=during day, -niapona=at dusk. Aspectual: -jaena=start, -weya=finish. Manner: -sa=in vain, -pe=completely, -pasi=short time, -titi=slowly. -me (causative) can also variably appear here (see pos 11).
Must follow adv.suf zone (pos 7); -shodi=in pain/pity, -limi=affectionate/small. Reverse order (*limi-shana-ta) ungrammatical.
-sawa=with difficulty/almost/counterfactual. Must follow adv.suf (pos 7) and expressive (pos 8).

Suffixal piece of interactional circumfix ja-...-ti. Must follow expressive (pos 8) and frustrative (pos 9). Left edge of non-interruption by free form combinations domain (vpref–auxiliary includes this).

Causative and completive; -eme=causative (also -me allomorph), -pe=completive. This position captures ordering when causative follows interactional -ti. When causative precedes -ti it occupies adv.suf zone (pos 7).
-ta=3A (third person A, third person plural A/S); -me=causative marker (possibly same form as -eme above but distinct function here as 3A per Table 1)
-ibo/-iba=finality/relevance marker. Must follow interactional -ti (pos 10). Suffixal piece of negative circumfix (pi-...-ma) can follow this position.

Right edge of narrow maximal ciscategorial domain (vpref–tamesuf) and minimal tso-marked subspan repetition domain. Temporal: -iki=recent past 1, -ja=recent past 2/lying, -asha=distant past, -isa=remote past. Posture: -ani=sitting, -bade=hanging, -neti=standing. Negation: -ma (right part of pi-...-ma circumfix). Motion: -yoa=wandering. Modal: -toa=possibility, -tame=counterfactual, -ke=imperative. -odi=freq/always (transcategorial). -tso=prior event/clause linker (suffix form).

Right edge of narrow maximal ciscategorial domain (vpref–aspect) and maximal auxiliary subspan repetition domain. -we=still/limitative, -isha=again/habitual. -isha takes its own L+H* pitch accent independent of host.

Auxiliary verbs; e-po=intransitive (do/be/go), e-a=transitive (do/say). Cannot be separated from main verb by NP. Can host positions vpref, ti, ta, tamesuf, and advsuf. Right edge of non-interruption by free form combinations domain.
Right edge of maximal free occurrence domain (vpref–connect3) and maximal tso-marked subspan repetition domain. tsio=while/when (bound per text). po=so/therefore. Also within L+H* pitch domain.
Post-verbal argument NPs/PPs/adverbials; free forms. Arguments cannot appear post-verbally in dependent clauses (tso-marked and tsio-marked clauses).
